name: Sylvan-Orrery
description: Rolling continents break around shallow seas, their interiors scored by massive canyon systems. Beyond an orbital debris ring, the land runs to a horizon that feels hand-drawn.

Light is the weather here. It swings from merciful to murderous within an hour, and everyone schedules their lives around it. Fossil beds suggest rich seas once flourished here; now the chemistry records only a slow suffocation.
Core samples from the deep crust contain isotopes with no known decay chain. The samples are stored off-world now, and studied reluctantly.
Whoever controls biomass controls the approach lanes. Three factions have done the arithmetic, and only two of them are being subtle about it.
